infobox.usage: Unlocks a door in spawn chamber 4 in The Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Key 04 (Key 04) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The engraving on this key is barely readable: it's either the number 4 or the Russian letter Ч. Could be useful for surviving the Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: Different locations in spawn chamber 4 inside The Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: Way to the lever that disables the shotgun trap.
